profile.visual_desc: Muscular grey-skinned entity with large bat-like wings. Wears a tattered blue loincloth and matching wrist wraps. Features multiple stone-colored horns and glowing red eyes.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Dramatic close-up of a monstrous face with deep-set glowing red eyes, protruding fangs, and thick grey horns. Skin is rugged and textured with a grimace.
profile.weapon_desc: Heavy clenched fists and natural physical strength.
profile.step1_ready: Frame 1 shows a front-isometric stance facing down-right. The entity stands tall with wings partially spread and arms slightly flared.
profile.step2_windup: Frames 2-3 depict the body crouching and pulling the right arm back. The wings flap upward to generate forward momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Frame 4 shows a forward lunge and punch. A bright circular energy burst appears at the fist's extension to indicate a heavy strike.
profile.step4_finish: Frames 5-6 show the entity holding the extended punch as the light effect dissipates, eventually resetting to a standing posture.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy impact in Frame 4 must center on the knuckles and project outward following the straight line of the punch's trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation adheres to reference motion. VFX centers on the fist and follows the punch trajectory accurately.
